title: Terminal behavior
notes: Typing into the focused terminal through the app, colors, the Cmd+F find bar with a query and its hits, and select all from the palette (Eli's keys don't bind it; herdr-frontend's `do` serves only the commands his tools use). Cmd-hover and Cmd-click on links need the pointer, which the harness doesn't drive: the headless tests cover them (crates/app/tests/scrollback.rs).

steps.name: find a word in the screen and scrollback

herdr-app.skip: Esc closes the find bar, and no command does
the palette's typing goes to herdr-frontend only
